purpose: Prepare and audit exact OKX native realized funding-rate and derivative mark-price H1 inputs for the frozen high-growth hourly-trim account. This is source coverage only: no wallet replay and no funding cash-flow estimate.

account_anchor.strategy: V1.7 target expires after one completed 12H interval; hourly 20% single-contract exposure cap; 9 slots; one original 2R partial and one original cloud runner

exact_path: Rebuild native children from cloud_close_target_expiry.time_in_force(cloud_close_thirds.okx_paths()), then restrict to the exact hourly-trim funded event_id roster. Do not reuse cloud_close_okx_funding_archives.funded_legs() as the exit-time source; it uses the older trend-input paths. Verified expected difference: 409 target-child exit times / 170 target-child phases, zero runner exit changes, unchanged 1911 instrument-month key union.

sources.monthly_realized_rates: Existing OKX per-instrument monthly funding-rate ZIP extracts under exp-cloud-close-okx-funding-archives-20261109-v1; raw files under data/research/cloud_close_okx_funding_20261109.
sources.daily_realized_rates: Official OKX GET /api/v5/public/market-data-history, module=3, instType=SWAP, instFamilyList=ANY, dateAggrType=daily. Download only daily allswap funding ZIPs needed to check frozen holding-window gaps. Preserve raw ZIPs in data/research/cloud_close_okx_funding_sources_20261109/allswap-daily.
sources.recent_realized_rates: Existing OKX GET /api/v5/public/funding-rate-history realizedRate supplement. Never use forecast fundingRate and never double-count monthly/daily/REST overlaps.
sources.mark_price_h1: Official OKX GET /api/v5/market/history-mark-price-candles with bar=1H. OHLC is derivative mark price, not last price or the underlying index. No index or spot candles may substitute.

coverage_rules.holding_window_ms: entry_ms minus one minute through native exit_bar_ms plus one hour except open-phase exits, then plus one minute; same conservative source-bracketing convention as the prior audit.
coverage_rules.source_gap_threshold: 8 hours plus 2 minutes; report gaps rather than imputing zero or forward-filling a rate.
coverage_rules.overlap_policy: Monthly per-contract rates remain authoritative. Daily allswap or recent REST rows may fill missing settlements only after instrument/time/rate reconciliation; do not add matching settlements twice.
coverage_rules.funding_interval: Use native funding_time timestamps; do not assume every instrument pays on a fixed 8-hour schedule.
coverage_rules.mark_bars: Retain UTC H1 bar-open milliseconds, open/high/low/close and confirmation state. Missing bars remain missing.

limitations: Source coverage does not establish a funding-adjusted account result.
Mark OHLC gives hourly bounds, not within-hour settlement ordering.
Funding marks, API availability and record timestamps are exchange-data evidence; exact cash attribution and a restarted 1000U account require a separate wallet implementation.
